t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. O me Nyame, medi adanseɛ sɛ Woabɔ me sɛ menhu Wo na mensom Wo. Medi adanseɛ seesei sɛ menni ahoɔden biara na Wo deɛ Woyɛ Otumfoɔ, medi hia buroburo na Woyɛ ɔdefoɔ. Onyame foforɔ biara nni hɔ ka Wo ho, ɔhaw mu Boafoɔ, Wo na wote Wo ho ne W’ase.
